verdict.rationale: Fastmail has automations: Filters & Rules and Sieve-style mail rules, so this story is a fair question for the product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents version history, change review, or rollback for those rules. The Filters & Rules items are bare titles, and Undo send concerns individual messages, not automation configuration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
